speaker: reginald
text: [clears throat] A critic has entered the Burger Bar. Carry on as if I weren't here. You can't, but do try.

speaker: reginald
text: I'm told the Tower is new. I review only the newest. Yesterday's food is history, and I don't do history. I do lunch.

speaker: reginald
text: A Tower! A monument! I shall review it floor by floor. Ground floor: sublime.

speaker: reginald
text: This will be reviewed separately. Harshly.
